name: app.toolsforfree/converter
title: Tools For Free
description: Free file conversion for agents: images, video, audio, documents, archives. No key or account.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find the conversion or tool for a job, e.g. "mov to mp4", "compress pdf" or "heic". Each result says how to call convert_file for it and which option keys it takes. The first result carries its option fields and rules; search the exact pair, e.g. "avi to gif", for the fields of another. Results marked browser only have a page and no API.

query.description: Formats or what to do, e.g. "mov mp4" or "remove pages".

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description: Convert a file, or run a tool on it, on the toolsforfree.app server. Name a conversion with from and to, or a tool with operation and format. Waits up to 40 seconds and returns a download link, with a small text result inline; a longer job comes back with what to pass to get_job. If you can run commands, send the raw file instead: curl --data-binary @FILE -H "content-type: application/octet-stream" "<httpApi from search_tools>" answers {taskId, engine}; then call get_job with those and the target format.

operation.description: A tool id from search_tools, e.g. "compress-video", instead of from and to.

format.description: The file's format id, with operation.

fileBase64.description: The file, base64-encoded. At most 6 MB.

options.description: Settings, as the option fields search_tools returns for the conversion or tool, e.g. {"image":{"quality":80}}. Anything else is refused with a message naming the field.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Keep waiting on a job convert_file handed back unfinished, or one sent to the HTTP API, and return its download link once it is done.

taskId.description: The taskId from convert_file's answer, or from the HTTP API's.

engine.description: The engine named in the same answer.

format.description: The format the job writes, e.g. "jpg": the format from the same answer.
